notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
🥊 BAKI HANMA: BLOOD ARENA – Demo Now Available!
Step into the arena and face off against the most brutal fighters from the Baki universe in this exclusive demo.
Do you have what it takes to survive a no-rules fight?

🔥 Experience intense 1v1 combat, fast-paced and unforgiving
🧠 Master timing, defense, and brutal counterattacks
💥 Fight iconic characters, each with unique fighting styles
🎮 Designed for fans of the manga, anime, and hardcore fighters alike

🛒 Download the demo now and add it to your wishlist!


Prove your strength. Only the toughest will remain standing.
